correctness.rationale: Every quantity is derived by direct multiplication of two 2x2 orthogonal projectors. The exact GMRES step solves its one-variable residual normal equation with w^TAw=1-z and ||Aw||²=(1-z)(1+z-z²). Exact squared residual and solution-error ratios follow, are strictly ordered for 0<z<1, and the derivative of the rational error excess has a unique interior zero. Full 2-step GMRES termination follows from det(w,Aw)=-cs³ != 0; AP remains nonzero at every finite sweep. The new packaged verify.py implements 2,485 exact-rational specializations and supplementary numeric maximization checks. Finite tests are supplementary, not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: A natural, measurable failure mode in residual-based acceleration of a prototypical fixed-point projection method is characterized for every principal angle, with both outcomes and unique sharp global penalty. The theorem distinguishes convergence in residual, actual solution-distance improvement, and two-step exact termination, providing a closed-form finite-horizon benchmark for acceleration and termination criteria. It is not an arbitrary sample, isolated parameter calculation, or claim that all GMRES solves are worse.
